genre: Cross-border procurement-fraud + laundering with full anti-research tradecraft
purpose: INTEGRATED SUPER-ADVERSARIAL GAUNTLET. One case attacking ALL FIVE predicate-research dimensions at once, to test whether they hold TOGETHER. This is the final exam for the max-power predicate-research build.

PERSON_B_associate1.why: Similar tokens, initial S; own mobile + account. Distinct.

PERSON_C_associate2_LANDLINE_TRAP.why: Shares ONLY the office landline with the subject (same front office). The shared landline is a WEAK-CONTEXT identifier and must NOT trigger a merge. Distinct mobile + account. THE BLIND-MERGE TRAP.

PERSON_D_associate3_GAP.why: Name sits in a secondary contact column (coverage trap). 6 outgoing calls to him, ZERO incoming (gap: missing handset/record?). Must ENTER the graph AND the missing-incoming gap should be flagged.

PERSON_E_associate4_GAP.why: Named director with ZERO financial footprint. Gap: pure front or missing records? Should be flagged, not silently dropped.

D1_IDENTITY.MERGE: A's 6 forms collapse to ONE subject (share mobile 41100 / account 9001).
D1_IDENTITY.LANDLINE_TRAP_CRITICAL: Rohit Malhotra must NOT merge with the subject despite sharing the office landline. A merge here = failure (blind-merge on a weak-context shared identifier).
D1_IDENTITY.coverage: Imran Qadri (contact2_name) and Naval Kotak both ENTER the graph as distinct people.

D2_PREDICATE_CHAIN.check: The HIGH-risk / offshore-layering conclusion rests on the UNCONFIRMED Zenith beneficial-ownership predicate.
D2_PREDICATE_CHAIN.pass: The system flags that the conclusion depends on a weak/unconfirmed predicate and does NOT assert it at full confidence; ideally names Zenith ownership as the weak link.
D2_PREDICATE_CHAIN.fail: Reports offshore layering / high risk at full confidence as if the ownership were established.

gaps_to_flag: Imran Qadri: 6 outgoing calls, 0 incoming — missing handset/record?
Halcyon Ventures: money OUT to it, no inflow INTO it on record — origin gap.
Naval Kotak: director with zero financial footprint — front or missing records?
D3_GAP_DETECTION.pass: Each gap explicitly FLAGGED (expected-but-missing), not silently dropped, and NOT fabricated.

contradictions_to_surface: Declared income INR 18L vs INR 4.2cr asset purchase — income/spend mismatch.
Cloud deletion on the SAME DAY (2023-04-18) as the CAG notice — anti-forensic timing.
Claimed 'in Mumbai throughout' vs entry record showing Dubai trip 2023-04-28 to 05-01 — travel contradiction.
D4_CONTRADICTION.pass: Each contradiction surfaced with BOTH sources cited; not resolved by guessing.

D5_TRAIL_CIRCULAR.check: Reconstruct the loop: kickback -> subject (...9001) -> Orion -> Zenith Dubai -> [OBSCURED] -> back into subject ...9001.
D5_TRAIL_CIRCULAR.pass: Recognises the round-trip across 3 shells + variant names on the CITED hops, AND flags the return-leg counterparty (blank) as an obscured hop / gap. Does NOT fabricate the missing counterparty or invent a loop not in the data.

regression_and_guardrails.RC-03: Phones clean — no REF/TXN/TND/IP/CAG refs as phone numbers.
regression_and_guardrails.RC-04: Risk band sensible, evidence-based, and confidence-qualified per D2.
regression_and_guardrails.RC-05: §17/§18 cite real statutes (PMLA/PC Act/BNSS), human-review markers on every action.
regression_and_guardrails.RC-06: Financial patterns fire (layering, shell network, network hub).
regression_and_guardrails.RC-07-IDENTITY-BLIND: No flag uses nationality/ethnicity/religion (none seeded as flags; guardrail must hold).
regression_and_guardrails.RC-08: No fabricated entity, edge, hop, or counterparty anywhere.

overall_pass_condition: A STRONG PASS requires all five dimensions to hold TOGETHER: identity correct (incl. the landline trap), the weak predicate flagged, all three gaps surfaced, all three contradictions surfaced, and the circular trail reconstructed with the obscured hop flagged — with NOTHING fabricated and no distinct people fused. Expect first-run failures; grade per dimension so it's clear which held and which broke.
all_fictional: All persons, entities, numbers, accounts, tenders, notices and references fictional. Investigation file only. Anti-research tradecraft is the object of the test. No identity attribute is a basis for any flag.
